##### Body

display_name: optional string or null



New human-readable name, 1 to 255 characters. Null clears it.



endpoint_url: optional string



The new base URL of the destination's OTLP/HTTP endpoint. The same rules as on create apply.

A change of hostname or port first removes every registered header, so send the headers for the new endpoint in the same request. When the destination has a `traces.endpoint_url`, such a change must also set `traces.endpoint_url` to a URL with the new hostname and port, or to `null`. A change of the path alone keeps the headers.

maxLength2048



headers: optional map\[string\] or null



Headers to set or remove. The API merges them into the destination's headers by name.

Names compare case-insensitively. A string value sets or replaces that header. A `null` value removes it. Headers that you omit don't change. The field itself can't be `null`.

A request that sets a header value must also include `endpoint_url`. The current URL is accepted.

The resulting set must stay within the same limits as on create. When the request sets a value, each stored value that it doesn't set counts as 4,096 bytes toward the 16,384-byte limit, because you can't read its real length. So to change one header of a destination that has four or more other headers, send the values of the others again in the same request.



state: optional [BetaTelemetryDestinationStateParams](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_state_params)



Whether the destination receives deliveries after the update. The field can't be `null`.

One of the following:



BetaTelemetryDestinationStateEnabledParams object{ type: "enabled" }



Start deliveries to the telemetry destination again.

This doesn't reset `delivery_health`.

type: "enabled"





BetaTelemetryDestinationStateDisabledParams object{ type: "disabled" }



Stop deliveries to the telemetry destination.

Spans produced while it is disabled aren't delivered later. A destination that is already disabled keeps its `reason`.

type: "disabled"





traces: optional [BetaTelemetryDestinationTracesParams](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_traces_params) { content_mode, enabled, endpoint_url, max_content_bytes } or null



The traces settings to change. Omitted settings keep their stored values.

`null` sets every traces setting to its create default.



content_mode: optional [BetaTelemetryDestinationContentMode](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_content_mode) or null



What the exported spans contain. Defaults to `metadata_only` on create.

On update, `null` sets `metadata_only`.

One of the following:

"metadata_only"



The spans contain identifiers, timing, status, token counts, and similar metadata. They don't contain prompt text, completion text, or tool inputs and outputs.



"content"



The spans contain the same metadata as `metadata_only`, plus message and tool content.

An organization with a data-handling restriction, such as under HIPAA, can't choose this mode. The API exports only metadata for such an organization, even to a destination that already has `content`.

enabled: optional boolean



Whether the destination receives traces. Defaults to true on create. It cannot be null.



endpoint_url: optional string or null



The full URL of your collector's traces endpoint, for a collector that takes traces on a path other than `/v1/traces`. The API posts traces to it exactly as given and appends nothing.

The same rules as for `endpoint_url` apply, except that any path is allowed. It must have the same scheme, host, and port as `endpoint_url`. At most 2,048 characters.

On create, `null` is the same as leaving it out. On update, `null` removes it. The API then posts traces to `endpoint_url` with `/v1/traces` appended. A change of this URL alone keeps the registered headers.

maxLength2048



max_content_bytes: optional number or null



The most bytes of content that one exported span can contain, from 1 up to the API's maximum. `null` sets no bound, so only the API's maximum applies.

On create, leaving it out is the same as `null`. The error for a value above the maximum states the maximum.

formatint32



workspaces: optional [BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesParams](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_workspaces_params)



The new workspace scope, in the same form as on create. The field can't be `null`.

The API refuses an update that changes the type or sends `workspace_ids` while the destination's list has more than 750 workspaces. Remove workspaces one at a time until 750 or fewer remain, then send the update again.

One of the following:

##### Returns



BetaTelemetryDestination object{ type: "telemetry_destination", id, created_at, 8 more }



An OpenTelemetry destination: an OTLP/HTTP endpoint, the request headers sent with every delivery to it, what the exported spans contain, and which workspaces it covers. A destination belongs to an organization. A workspace's spans go to every enabled destination that covers it.

Update a Telemetry Destination

cURL



```python
curl https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations/$DESTINATION_ID \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H 'anthropic-version: 2026-10-21' \
    -H 'anthropic-beta: telemetry-destinations-2026-08-11' \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" \
    -d '{}'
```

Response 200



```python
{
  "id": "id",
  "created_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "delivery_health": {
    "last_error": "last_error",
    "last_error_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
    "last_success_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z"
  },
  "display_name": "display_name",
  "endpoint_url": "endpoint_url",
  "header_names": [
    "string"
  ],
  "state": {
    "type": "enabled"
  },
  "traces": {
    "content_mode": "metadata_only",
    "enabled": true,
    "endpoint_url": "endpoint_url",
    "max_content_bytes": 0
  },
  "type": "telemetry_destination",
  "updated_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "workspaces": {
    "type": "all"
  }
}
```

# Add a Telemetry Destination Workspace

Copy page



API version 2023-06-01

cURL

POST/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations/{destination_id}/workspaces/{workspace_id}

Add one workspace to a destination's workspace list.

Under `include` the workspace's spans start going to the destination. Under `exclude` they stop. A list holds at most 1,000 workspaces.

Adding a workspace that is already on the list changes nothing and returns the existing entry. An archived workspace that isn't on the list yet can't be added. A destination whose `workspaces.type` is `all` doesn't have a list, so the API returns 400. To change which workspaces such a destination covers, update its `workspaces`.

See the [OpenTelemetry export guide](../Other/manage-claude-opentelemetry.md#choose-workspaces-for-a-destination) to learn more about choosing the workspaces of a destination.

##### Path parameters

destination_id: string



ID of the destination (`tdst_...`).

workspace_id: string



ID of the workspace to add (`wrkspc_...`).

##### Headers



"anthropic-version": optional string



The version of the Claude API you want to use.

Read more about versioning and our version history [here](../Endpoints/versioning.md).



"anthropic-beta": optional array of [AnthropicBeta](../Endpoints/platform-claude-com-http-beta.md#anthropic_beta)



This endpoint is in beta: requests must send `telemetry-destinations-2026-08-11` in this header.

One of the following:

##### Returns



BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspace object{ type: "telemetry_destination_workspace", created_at, telemetry_destination_id, workspace_id }



A workspace on a telemetry destination's workspace list.

Under `include`, the destination covers the workspace. Under `exclude`, the destination covers every workspace except this one. The entry doesn't have an `id`. Its `telemetry_destination_id` and `workspace_id` together identify it.

type: "telemetry_destination_workspace"





created_at: string



Time the workspace was added to the list.

formatdate-time

telemetry_destination_id: string



ID of the telemetry destination (`tdst_...`).

workspace_id: string



ID of the workspace (`wrkspc_...`).

Add a Telemetry Destination Workspace

cURL



```python
curl https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations/$DESTINATION_ID/workspaces/$WORKSPACE_ID \
    -X POST \
    -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
    -H 'anthropic-beta: telemetry-destinations-2026-08-11' \
    -H "X-Api-Key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
```

Response 200



```python
{
  "created_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "telemetry_destination_id": "telemetry_destination_id",
  "type": "telemetry_destination_workspace",
  "workspace_id": "workspace_id"
}
```

# List Telemetry Destination Workspaces

Copy page



API version 2026-10-21

cURL

GET/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations/{destination_id}/workspaces

List the workspaces on a destination's workspace list, newest entry first.

A destination whose `workspaces.type` is `all` doesn't have a list, so its page is empty. The list includes archived workspaces.

See the [OpenTelemetry export guide](../Other/manage-claude-opentelemetry.md#choose-workspaces-for-a-destination) to learn more about choosing the workspaces of a destination.

##### Path parameters

destination_id: string



ID of the destination (`tdst_...`).

##### Query parameters



limit: optional number



Number of entries to return per page, between 1 and 1,000. Defaults to 20.

formatint32

page: optional string



Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_page`. Leave it out to get the first page.

##### Headers



"anthropic-version": optional string



The version of the Claude API you want to use.

Read more about versioning and our version history [here](../Endpoints/versioning.md).



"anthropic-beta": optional array of [AnthropicBeta](../Endpoints/platform-claude-com-http-beta.md#anthropic_beta)

# Remove a Telemetry Destination Workspace

Copy page



API version 2026-10-21

cURL

DELETE/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations/{destination_id}/workspaces/{workspace_id}

Remove one workspace from a destination's workspace list.

Under `include` the workspace's spans stop going to the destination. Under `exclude` they start. An archived workspace can be removed too.

The API returns 404 when the workspace isn't on the list. A destination whose `workspaces.type` is `all` doesn't have a list, so the API returns 400.

See the [OpenTelemetry export guide](../Other/manage-claude-opentelemetry.md#choose-workspaces-for-a-destination) to learn more about choosing the workspaces of a destination.

##### Path parameters

destination_id: string



ID of the destination (`tdst_...`).

workspace_id: string



ID of the workspace to remove (`wrkspc_...`).

##### Headers



"anthropic-version": optional string



The version of the Claude API you want to use.

Read more about versioning and our version history [here](../Endpoints/versioning.md).



"anthropic-beta": optional array of [AnthropicBeta](../Endpoints/platform-claude-com-http-beta.md#anthropic_beta)

# Workspaces

Copy page



API version 2023-06-01

cURL

##### [List Telemetry Destination Workspaces](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations/workspaces/list)

GET/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations/{destination_id}/workspaces

List the workspaces on a destination's workspace list, newest entry first.

##### [Add a Telemetry Destination Workspace](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations/workspaces/add)

POST/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations/{destination_id}/workspaces/{workspace_id}

Add one workspace to a destination's workspace list.

##### [Remove a Telemetry Destination Workspace](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations/workspaces/remove)

DELETE/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations/{destination_id}/workspaces/{workspace_id}

Remove one workspace from a destination's workspace list.

##### Models



BetaDeletedTelemetryDestinationWorkspace object{ type: "telemetry_destination_workspace_deleted", telemetry_destination_id, workspace_id }



Confirmation that a workspace was removed from a destination's list.

type: "telemetry_destination_workspace_deleted"



telemetry_destination_id: string



ID of the telemetry destination (`tdst_...`).

workspace_id: string



ID of the workspace that was removed (`wrkspc_...`).



BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspace object{ type: "telemetry_destination_workspace", created_at, telemetry_destination_id, workspace_id }



A workspace on a telemetry destination's workspace list.

Under `include`, the destination covers the workspace. Under `exclude`, the destination covers every workspace except this one. The entry doesn't have an `id`. Its `telemetry_destination_id` and `workspace_id` together identify it.

type: "telemetry_destination_workspace"





created_at: string



Time the workspace was added to the list.

formatdate-time

telemetry_destination_id: string



ID of the telemetry destination (`tdst_...`).

workspace_id: string



ID of the workspace (`wrkspc_...`).

# Telemetry Destinations

Copy page



API version 2023-06-01

cURL

##### [Create a Telemetry Destination](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations/create)

POST/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations

Register an OpenTelemetry destination for the organization.

##### [List Telemetry Destinations](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations/list)

GET/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations

List the organization's destinations, newest first, optionally only those that cover given workspaces.

##### [Retrieve a Telemetry Destination](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations/retrieve)

GET/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations/{destination_id}

Read a destination's configuration, state, and most recent delivery results.

##### [Update a Telemetry Destination](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations/update)

POST/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations/{destination_id}

Change a telemetry destination's settings, its state, or which workspaces it covers.

##### [Delete a Telemetry Destination](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations/delete)

DELETE/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations/{destination_id}

Delete a destination and its workspace list.

##### [Test a Telemetry Destination](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations/test)

POST/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations/{destination_id}/test

Send one test span, named `anthropic.test`, to the destination with its registered headers, once and without retries, and report the destination's answer. The response is 200 whether or not the destination answered with a 2xx status: its `result` has the type `success`, or the type `failure` and the reason in `error`. The destination's configuration, `state` and `delivery_health` do not change. A disabled destination can be tested too. Wait 10 seconds between tests of one destination; a request that comes sooner may be answered with status 429.

##### Models



BetaDeletedTelemetryDestination object{ type: "telemetry_destination_deleted", id }



Confirmation that a destination was deleted.

type: "telemetry_destination_deleted"



id: string



ID of the deleted destination (`tdst_...`).

BetaTelemetryDestination object{ type: "telemetry_destination", id, created_at, 8 more }



An OpenTelemetry destination: an OTLP/HTTP endpoint, the request headers sent with every delivery to it, what the exported spans contain, and which workspaces it covers. A destination belongs to an organization. A workspace's spans go to every enabled destination that covers it.



BetaTelemetryDestinationContentMode = "metadata_only" or "content"



What the spans that the API exports to a telemetry destination contain.

See the [OpenTelemetry export guide](../Other/manage-claude-opentelemetry.md#choose-a-content-mode) to learn what the spans contain in each content mode.

One of the following:

"metadata_only"



The spans contain identifiers, timing, status, token counts, and similar metadata. They don't contain prompt text, completion text, or tool inputs and outputs.



"content"



The spans contain the same metadata as `metadata_only`, plus message and tool content.

An organization with a data-handling restriction, such as under HIPAA, can't choose this mode. The API exports only metadata for such an organization, even to a destination that already has `content`.



BetaTelemetryDestinationDeliveryHealth object{ last_error, last_error_at, last_success_at }



The most recent delivery results that the API records for a telemetry destination.

Changes to the destination's configuration or state don't reset these fields. Changes to these fields don't change `updated_at`. The values can lag behind the latest deliveries.

See the [OpenTelemetry export guide](../Other/manage-claude-opentelemetry.md#delivery-and-health) to learn how the API delivers spans and when it disables a destination.



last_error: string or null



A message that describes the most recent failed delivery to the destination, or `null` if no delivery has failed yet.

Examples are `temporary DNS failure`, `TLS failure`, `timeout`, `connection failure`, `invalid address`, `HTTP error (status 503)`, and `redirect (status 301)`. The message is `invalid address` both for a hostname that doesn't exist and for an address that isn't publicly routable. It never contains the endpoint's response body, a header value, a network address, or TLS details.

`last_error` and `last_error_at` always change together. A later successful delivery doesn't clear them. If `last_success_at` is later than `last_error_at`, a delivery has succeeded since this failure.

See the [OpenTelemetry export guide](../Other/manage-claude-opentelemetry.md#delivery-errors) to learn the likely cause of each error.



last_error_at: string or null



Time of the failure that `last_error` describes. Changes together with `last_error`. Null until a delivery first fails.

formatdate-time



last_success_at: string or null



Time of the most recent successful delivery to the destination, or `null` if no delivery has succeeded yet.

formatdate-time



BetaTelemetryDestinationDisabledReason = [BetaTelemetryDestinationDisabledReasonCaller](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_disabled_reason_caller) or [BetaTelemetryDestinationDisabledReasonSustainedFailure](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_disabled_reason_sustained_failure) or [BetaTelemetryDestinationDisabledReasonInvalidAddress](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_disabled_reason_invalid_address) or [BetaTelemetryDestinationDisabledReasonRedirect](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_disabled_reason_redirect)



Why the destination is disabled: `caller` when a caller disabled it, or the reason the API disabled it automatically (`sustained_failure`, `invalid_address`, or `redirect`). Every automatic disable is reversible with an update that sets `state` to `enabled`. An update that sets `disabled` on a destination that is already disabled keeps its reason.

One of the following:



BetaTelemetryDestinationDisabledReasonCaller object{ type: "caller" }



A caller disabled the destination with an update that set `state` to `disabled`.

type: "caller"





BetaTelemetryDestinationDisabledReasonInvalidAddress object{ type: "invalid_address" }



The API disabled the destination because deliveries to it failed for longer than the same threshold as for `sustained_failure`, and the most recent failed delivery failed with an invalid address: the DNS answer says that the endpoint's hostname doesn't exist or doesn't have an address, or the address that the API would connect to isn't publicly routable or is reserved, for example a loopback, link-local, private-network, or cloud-metadata address. The API doesn't connect to such an address, and retries the delivery a bounded number of times as it does after a timeout. A timeout or a server failure of the DNS lookup is a temporary DNS failure instead, not an invalid address.

type: "invalid_address"





BetaTelemetryDestinationDisabledReasonRedirect object{ type: "redirect" }



The API disabled the destination because the endpoint answered a delivery with a 3xx status. Redirects are never followed, and one such answer disables the destination at once.

type: "redirect"





BetaTelemetryDestinationDisabledReasonSustainedFailure object{ type: "sustained_failure" }



The API disabled the destination because deliveries to it failed, with no successful delivery in between, for longer than a threshold that Anthropic configures and that is not part of this contract. The reason is `invalid_address` instead when the most recent failed delivery failed with an invalid address.

type: "sustained_failure"





BetaTelemetryDestinationState = [BetaTelemetryDestinationStateEnabled](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_state_enabled) or [BetaTelemetryDestinationStateDisabled](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_state_disabled)



Whether a telemetry destination receives deliveries.

A caller can set either state. The API also disables an enabled destination on its own in some cases. The `reason` of the disabled state says whether a caller or the API disabled the destination and, when the API did, why.

See the [OpenTelemetry export guide](../Other/manage-claude-opentelemetry.md#delivery-and-health) to learn when the API disables a destination.

One of the following:

BetaTelemetryDestinationTraces object{ content_mode, enabled, endpoint_url, max_content_bytes }



A telemetry destination's settings for the traces it receives.



content_mode: [BetaTelemetryDestinationContentMode](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_content_mode)



What the exported spans contain.

One of the following:

"metadata_only"



The spans contain identifiers, timing, status, token counts, and similar metadata. They don't contain prompt text, completion text, or tool inputs and outputs.



"content"



The spans contain the same metadata as `metadata_only`, plus message and tool content.

An organization with a data-handling restriction, such as under HIPAA, can't choose this mode. The API exports only metadata for such an organization, even to a destination that already has `content`.

enabled: boolean



Whether the destination receives traces. A destination whose `enabled` is false keeps its other settings.



endpoint_url: string or null



The full URL that the API posts traces to, exactly as registered, or `null` if the destination doesn't have one.

When it is `null`, the API posts traces to `endpoint_url` with `/v1/traces` appended.



max_content_bytes: number or null



The most bytes of content that one exported span can contain, or `null` if only the API's maximum applies.

Content means model prompts and responses, and tool inputs and outputs. The API shortens longer content to this size before it delivers the span. A destination whose `content_mode` is `metadata_only` keeps this value. It applies once `content_mode` is `content`.

formatint32



BetaTelemetryDestinationTracesParams object{ content_mode, enabled, endpoint_url, max_content_bytes }



The settings for the traces that a telemetry destination receives, as a create or update request sets them. An omitted field takes its default on create and keeps its stored value on update.



content_mode: optional [BetaTelemetryDestinationContentMode](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_content_mode) or null



What the exported spans contain. Defaults to `metadata_only` on create.

On update, `null` sets `metadata_only`.

One of the following:

"metadata_only"



The spans contain identifiers, timing, status, token counts, and similar metadata. They don't contain prompt text, completion text, or tool inputs and outputs.



"content"



The spans contain the same metadata as `metadata_only`, plus message and tool content.

An organization with a data-handling restriction, such as under HIPAA, can't choose this mode. The API exports only metadata for such an organization, even to a destination that already has `content`.

enabled: optional boolean



Whether the destination receives traces. Defaults to true on create. It cannot be null.



endpoint_url: optional string or null



The full URL of your collector's traces endpoint, for a collector that takes traces on a path other than `/v1/traces`. The API posts traces to it exactly as given and appends nothing.

The same rules as for `endpoint_url` apply, except that any path is allowed. It must have the same scheme, host, and port as `endpoint_url`. At most 2,048 characters.

On create, `null` is the same as leaving it out. On update, `null` removes it. The API then posts traces to `endpoint_url` with `/v1/traces` appended. A change of this URL alone keeps the registered headers.

maxLength2048



max_content_bytes: optional number or null



The most bytes of content that one exported span can contain, from 1 up to the API's maximum. `null` sets no bound, so only the API's maximum applies.

On create, leaving it out is the same as `null`. The error for a value above the maximum states the maximum.

formatint32



BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspaces = [BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesAll](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_workspaces_all) or [BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesInclude](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_workspaces_include) or [BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesExclude](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_workspaces_exclude)



Which of the organization's workspaces a telemetry destination covers.

Several destinations can cover the same workspace. Each of them receives the workspace's spans while it is enabled.

The workspace list of an `include` or `exclude` destination isn't part of the destination object. List the destination's workspaces to read it. Add or remove one workspace at a time, or replace the whole list with an update. A list holds at most 1,000 workspaces.

One of the following:



BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesAll object{ type: "all" }



The destination covers every workspace of the organization, including the default workspace, archived workspaces, and workspaces created later. It doesn't have a list.

type: "all"





BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesInclude object{ type: "include" }



The destination covers the workspaces on its list, and no others.

type: "include"





BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesExclude object{ type: "exclude" }



The destination covers every workspace of the organization except the workspaces on its list. A workspace created later is covered until it is added to the list.

type: "exclude"





BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesAll object{ type: "all" }



The destination covers every workspace of the organization, including the default workspace, archived workspaces, and workspaces created later. It doesn't have a list.

type: "all"





BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesAllParams object{ type: "all" }



Cover every workspace of the organization. Doesn't take `workspace_ids`.

An update that sets `all` empties the destination's workspace list.

type: "all"





BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesExclude object{ type: "exclude" }



The destination covers every workspace of the organization except the workspaces on its list. A workspace created later is covered until it is added to the list.

type: "exclude"





BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesExcludeParams object{ type: "exclude", workspace_ids }



Cover every workspace of the organization except the workspaces on the list.

type: "exclude"





workspace_ids: optional array of string



The IDs of the workspaces on the destination's list (`wrkspc_...`). At most 100 per request.

On create, these workspaces become the destination's list. If you leave `workspace_ids` out, the list starts empty. If the API refuses one of the IDs, it doesn't create the destination.

On update, `workspace_ids` replaces the whole list. A workspace that stays on the list keeps its entry and its `created_at`. An empty array empties the list. If you leave `workspace_ids` out and the type stays the same, the list doesn't change. If you leave it out and the type changes, the new list starts empty. After a change to `include` without `workspace_ids`, the destination doesn't cover any workspace until one is added. After a change to `exclude` without `workspace_ids`, it covers every workspace.

An ID sent more than once is added once. An archived workspace can't be added to a list. An update can keep an archived workspace that is already on the list.



BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesInclude object{ type: "include" }



The destination covers the workspaces on its list, and no others.

type: "include"





BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesIncludeParams object{ type: "include", workspace_ids }



Cover only the workspaces on the list.

type: "include"





workspace_ids: optional array of string



The IDs of the workspaces on the destination's list (`wrkspc_...`). At most 100 per request.

On create, these workspaces become the destination's list. If you leave `workspace_ids` out, the list starts empty. If the API refuses one of the IDs, it doesn't create the destination.

On update, `workspace_ids` replaces the whole list. A workspace that stays on the list keeps its entry and its `created_at`. An empty array empties the list. If you leave `workspace_ids` out and the type stays the same, the list doesn't change. If you leave it out and the type changes, the new list starts empty. After a change to `include` without `workspace_ids`, the destination doesn't cover any workspace until one is added. After a change to `exclude` without `workspace_ids`, it covers every workspace.

An ID sent more than once is added once. An archived workspace can't be added to a list. An update can keep an archived workspace that is already on the list.



BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesParams = [BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesAllParams](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_workspaces_all_params) or [BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesIncludeParams](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_workspaces_include_params) or [BetaTelemetryDestinationWorkspacesExcludeParams](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations#beta_telemetry_destination_workspaces_exclude_params)



Which of the organization's workspaces a telemetry destination covers, as a create or update request sets it.

One of the following:

#### Telemetry Destinations[Workspaces](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations/workspaces)

##### [List Telemetry Destination Workspaces](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations/workspaces/list)

GET/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations/{destination_id}/workspaces

List the workspaces on a destination's workspace list, newest entry first.

##### [Add a Telemetry Destination Workspace](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations/workspaces/add)

POST/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations/{destination_id}/workspaces/{workspace_id}

Add one workspace to a destination's workspace list.

##### [Remove a Telemetry Destination Workspace](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/telemetry_destinations/workspaces/remove)

DELETE/v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations/{destination_id}/workspaces/{workspace_id}

Remove one workspace from a destination's workspace list.

# Get Claude Code Usage Report

Copy page



cURL

GET/v1/organizations/usage_report/claude_code

Retrieve daily aggregated usage metrics for Claude Code users. Enables organizations to analyze developer productivity and build custom dashboards.

##### Query parameters



starting_at: string



UTC date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Returns metrics for this single day only.

formatdate

pattern^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\$



limit: optional number



Number of records per page (default: 20, max: 1000).

default20

minimum1

maximum1000

page: optional string



Opaque cursor token from previous response's `next_page` field.

##### Headers



"anthropic-version": optional string



The version of the Claude API you want to use.

Read more about versioning and our version history [here](../Endpoints/versioning.md).

##### Returns



BetaClaudeCodeUsageReport object{ data, has_more, next_page }



Get Claude Code Usage Report



```python
curl https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/usage_report/claude_code \
    -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
    -H "X-Api-Key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
```

# Get Messages Usage Report

Copy page



cURL

GET/v1/organizations/usage_report/messages

Get Messages Usage Report

##### Query parameters



starting_at: string



Time buckets that start on or after this RFC 3339 timestamp will be returned. Each time bucket will be snapped to the start of the minute/hour/day in UTC.

formatdate-time

account_ids: optional array of string



Restrict usage returned to the specified user account ID(s).

api_key_ids: optional array of string



Restrict usage returned to the specified API key ID(s).



bucket_width: optional "1d" or "1h" or "1m"



Time granularity of the response data.

default1d

One of the following:

"1d"



"1h"



"1m"





context_window: optional array of [BetaAnalyticsContextWindow](platform-claude-com-http-beta-organization-analytics.md#beta_analytics_context_window)



Restrict usage returned to the specified context window(s).

One of the following:

"0-200k"



"200k-1M"





ending_at: optional string



Time buckets that end before this RFC 3339 timestamp will be returned.

formatdate-time



group_by: optional array of "account_id" or "api_key_id" or "context_window" or 6 more



Group by any subset of the available options.

One of the following:

"account_id"



"api_key_id"



"context_window"



"inference_geo"



"model"



"service_account_id"



"service_tier"



"speed"



"workspace_id"





inference_geos: optional array of [BetaAnalyticsInferenceGeoFilter](platform-claude-com-http-beta-organization-analytics.md#beta_analytics_inference_geo_filter)



Restrict usage returned to the specified inference geo(s). Use `not_available` for models that do not support specifying `inference_geo`.

One of the following:

"global"



"not_available"



"us"





limit: optional number



Maximum number of time buckets to return in the response.

The default and max limits depend on `bucket_width`: • `"1d"`: Default of 7 days, maximum of 31 days • `"1h"`: Default of 24 hours, maximum of 168 hours • `"1m"`: Default of 60 minutes, maximum of 1440 minutes

models: optional array of string



Restrict usage returned to the specified model(s).

page: optional string



Optionally set to the `next_page` token from the previous response.

service_account_ids: optional array of string



Restrict usage returned to the specified service account ID(s).



service_tiers: optional array of "batch" or "flex" or "flex_discount" or 3 more



Restrict usage returned to the specified service tier(s).

One of the following:

"batch"



"flex"



"flex_discount"



"priority"



"priority_on_demand"



"standard"





speeds: optional array of "standard" or "fast"



Restrict usage returned to the specified speed(s).

One of the following:

"standard"



"fast"



workspace_ids: optional array of string



Restrict usage returned to the specified workspace ID(s).

# List Users

Copy page



cURL

GET/v1/organizations/users

List the organization's members.

##### Query parameters

after_id: optional string



ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.

before_id: optional string



ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately before this object.



email: optional string



Filter by user email.

formatemail



limit: optional number



Number of items to return per page.

Defaults to `20`. Ranges from `1` to `1000`.

default20

minimum1

maximum1000



roles: optional array of string



Filter to items whose `role` equals one of the supplied values. Repeatable; values are OR'ed together.

Accepted values depend on the organization type: Console and API organizations accept `user`, `developer`, `billing`, `admin`, and `claude_code_user`; Claude Enterprise organizations accept `user`, `owner`, `primary_owner`, `membership_admin`, and `managed`.

##### Headers



"anthropic-version": optional string



The version of the Claude API you want to use.

Read more about versioning and our version history [here](../Endpoints/versioning.md).

##### Returns



data: array of [BetaOrganizationUser](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/users#beta_organization_user) { type: "user", id, added_at, 3 more }





type: "user"



Object type.

For Users, this is always `"user"`.

defaultuser

id: string



ID of the User.



added_at: string



RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the User joined the Organization.

formatdate-time

email: string



Email of the User.

name: string



Name of the User.



role: [BetaOrganizationRole](platform-claude-com-http-beta-organization.md#beta_organization_role)



Organization role of the User.

One of the following:

"admin"



"billing"



"claude_code_user"



"developer"



"managed"



"membership_admin"



"owner"



"primary_owner"



"user"



first_id: string or null



First ID in the `data` list. Can be used as the `before_id` for the previous page.

has_more: boolean



Indicates if there are more results in the requested page direction.

last_id: string or null



Last ID in the `data` list. Can be used as the `after_id` for the next page.

List Users

cURL



```python
curl https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/users \
    -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
    -H "X-Api-Key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
```

Response 200



```python
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "user_01WCz1FkmYMm4gnmykNKUu3Q",
      "added_at": "2024-10-30T23:58:27.427722Z",
      "email": "user@emaildomain.com",
      "name": "Jane Doe",
      "role": "admin",
      "type": "user"
    }
  ],
  "first_id": "first_id",
  "has_more": true,
  "last_id": "last_id"
}
```

##### Returns Examples

Response 200



```python
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "user_01WCz1FkmYMm4gnmykNKUu3Q",
      "added_at": "2024-10-30T23:58:27.427722Z",
      "email": "user@emaildomain.com",

# Remove User

DELETE/v1/organizations/users/{user_id}

Remove a member from the organization.

##### Path parameters

user_id: string



ID of the User.

##### Returns



type: "user_deleted"



Deleted object type.

For Users, this is always `"user_deleted"`.

defaultuser_deleted

id: string



ID of the User.

Remove User

cURL



```python
curl https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/users/$USER_ID \
    -X DELETE \
    -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
    -H "X-Api-Key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
```

Response 200



```python
{
  "id": "user_01WCz1FkmYMm4gnmykNKUu3Q",
  "type": "user_deleted"
}
```

##### Returns Examples

Response 200



```python
{
  "id": "user_01WCz1FkmYMm4gnmykNKUu3Q",

# Update User

POST/v1/organizations/users/{user_id}

Update a member's organization role.

##### Path parameters

user_id: string



ID of the User.

##### Body



role: "billing" or "claude_code_user" or "developer" or 2 more



New role for the User.

The accepted values depend on the organization type. Console and API organizations accept `user`, `developer`, `billing`, and `claude_code_user`; `admin` cannot be assigned through the API. Claude Enterprise organizations accept `user` and `managed`.

One of the following:

"billing"



"claude_code_user"



"developer"



"managed"



"user"



##### Returns



BetaOrganizationUser object{ type: "user", id, added_at, 3 more }





type: "user"



Object type.

For Users, this is always `"user"`.

defaultuser

id: string



ID of the User.



added_at: string



RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the User joined the Organization.

formatdate-time

email: string



Email of the User.

name: string



Name of the User.



role: [BetaOrganizationRole](platform-claude-com-http-beta-organization.md#beta_organization_role)



Organization role of the User.

One of the following:

"admin"



"billing"



"claude_code_user"



"developer"



"managed"



"membership_admin"



"owner"



"primary_owner"



"user"



Update User

cURL



```python
curl https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/users/$USER_ID \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
    -H "X-Api-Key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" \
    -d '{
          "role": "user"
        }'
```

Response 200



```python
{
  "id": "user_01WCz1FkmYMm4gnmykNKUu3Q",
  "added_at": "2024-10-30T23:58:27.427722Z",
  "email": "user@emaildomain.com",
  "name": "Jane Doe",
  "role": "admin",
  "type": "user"
}
```

# Create Organization Webhook Endpoint

Copy page



cURL

POST/v1/organizations/webhooks

Create an organization webhook endpoint.

An organization webhook endpoint belongs to the organization rather than to one of its workspaces. An organization can have at most 32 organization webhook endpoints, enabled or disabled.

The response includes the endpoint's signing secret. No read returns it, so store it when you receive it.

Every request must include the beta header `anthropic-beta: webhooks-2026-10-07`. A request without it returns `404`, exactly as if this API did not exist. Anthropic turns organization webhook endpoints on for each organization; until yours is on, requests also return `404`. Organization webhook endpoints are in beta and are not available to organizations with HIPAA readiness enabled.

##### Headers



"anthropic-version": optional string



The version of the Claude API you want to use.

Read more about versioning and our version history [here](../Endpoints/versioning.md).



"anthropic-beta": optional array of [AnthropicBeta](../Endpoints/platform-claude-com-http-beta.md#anthropic_beta)



This endpoint is in beta: requests must send `webhooks-2026-10-07` in this header.

One of the following:

string

"message-batches-2024-09-24"

"prompt-caching-2024-07-31"

Create Organization Webhook Endpoint

cURL



```python
curl https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/webhooks \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
    -H 'anthropic-beta: webhooks-2026-10-07' \
    -H "X-Api-Key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" \
    -d '{
          "enabled_events": [
            "user_profile.enforcement_action_opened"
          ],
          "url": "x"
        }'
```

  "signing_secret": "signing_secret",
  "state": "disabled",

# Delete Organization Webhook Endpoint

Copy page



cURL

DELETE/v1/organizations/webhooks/{webhook_endpoint_id}

Delete an organization webhook endpoint.

Every request must include the beta header `anthropic-beta: webhooks-2026-10-07`. A request without it returns `404`, exactly as if this API did not exist. Anthropic turns organization webhook endpoints on for each organization; until yours is on, requests also return `404`. Organization webhook endpoints are in beta and are not available to organizations with HIPAA readiness enabled.

# List Organization Webhook Endpoints

Copy page



cURL

GET/v1/organizations/webhooks

List the organization's webhook endpoints.

An organization webhook endpoint belongs to the organization rather than to one of its workspaces. The list does not include webhook endpoints that belong to a workspace.

Every request must include the beta header `anthropic-beta: webhooks-2026-10-07`. A request without it returns `404`, exactly as if this API did not exist. Anthropic turns organization webhook endpoints on for each organization; until yours is on, requests also return `404`. Organization webhook endpoints are in beta and are not available to organizations with HIPAA readiness enabled.

##### Query parameters

after_id: optional string



ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.

before_id: optional string



ID of a webhook endpoint to use as a cursor. Returns the first `limit` endpoints that come before it in list order, not the `limit` endpoints just before it.



limit: optional number



Number of items to return per page, up to `100`. The default, `0`, means `20`.

default0

minimum0

maximum100



order: optional "asc" or "desc"



Sort order by `created_at`. Defaults to `desc`, newest first.

One of the following:

"asc"



"desc"



##### Headers



"anthropic-version": optional string



The version of the Claude API you want to use.

Read more about versioning and our version history [here](../Endpoints/versioning.md).



"anthropic-beta": optional array of [AnthropicBeta](../Endpoints/platform-claude-com-http-beta.md#anthropic_beta)



This endpoint is in beta: requests must send `webhooks-2026-10-07` in this header.

##### Returns



data: array of [BetaOrganizationWebhookEndpoint](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/webhooks#beta_organization_webhook_endpoint) { id, created_at, description, 6 more }



The organization webhook endpoints on this page.

id: string



ID of the webhook endpoint.



created_at: string



When the endpoint was created, in RFC 3339 format.

formatdate-time

description: string



Notes about the endpoint. An empty string when none were given.

disabled_reason: string



Why Anthropic disabled the endpoint automatically. An empty string when the endpoint is enabled, or when you disabled it.



enabled_events: array of "user_profile.enforcement_action_opened" or "user_profile.enforcement_action_resolved"



The event types delivered to the endpoint.

One of the following:

"user_profile.enforcement_action_opened"



"user_profile.enforcement_action_resolved"



name: string



A short label for the endpoint. An empty string when none was given.



state: [BetaOrganizationWebhookEndpointState](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/webhooks#beta_organization_webhook_endpoint_state)



Whether deliveries are sent to the endpoint.

One of the following:

"disabled"



"enabled"





updated_at: string



When the endpoint was last changed, in RFC 3339 format.

formatdate-time

url: string



The HTTPS URL that deliveries are sent to.

has_more: boolean



Whether more endpoints follow this page in list order. With `before_id`, only endpoints before the cursor count.

first_id: optional string or null



First ID in the `data` list.

last_id: optional string or null



Last ID in the `data` list. Can be used as the `after_id` for the next page.

    -H "X-Api-Key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
```

Response 200



{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "id",

        "user_profile.enforcement_action_opened"
      ],

      "state": "disabled",
      "updated_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
      "url": "url"
    }
  ],
  "has_more": true,
  "first_id": "first_id",
  "last_id": "last_id"
}
```

# Regenerate Organization Webhook Endpoint Signing Secret

Copy page



cURL

POST/v1/organizations/webhooks/{webhook_endpoint_id}/regenerate_signing_secret

Replace an organization webhook endpoint's signing secret. The old secret stops working immediately. The new secret is returned only in this response.

Every request must include the beta header `anthropic-beta: webhooks-2026-10-07`. A request without it returns `404`, exactly as if this API did not exist. Anthropic turns organization webhook endpoints on for each organization; until yours is on, requests also return `404`. Organization webhook endpoints are in beta and are not available to organizations with HIPAA readiness enabled.

##### Path parameters



webhook_endpoint_id: string



ID of the webhook endpoint.

maxLength2048

##### Headers



"anthropic-version": optional string



The version of the Claude API you want to use.

Read more about versioning and our version history [here](../Endpoints/versioning.md).



"anthropic-beta": optional array of [AnthropicBeta](../Endpoints/platform-claude-com-http-beta.md#anthropic_beta)



This endpoint is in beta: requests must send `webhooks-2026-10-07` in this header.

One of the following:

string

"message-batches-2024-09-24"

"computer-use-2024-10-22"

# Get Organization Webhook Endpoint

Copy page



cURL

GET/v1/organizations/webhooks/{webhook_endpoint_id}

Retrieve an organization webhook endpoint by ID.

Every request must include the beta header `anthropic-beta: webhooks-2026-10-07`. A request without it returns `404`, exactly as if this API did not exist. Anthropic turns organization webhook endpoints on for each organization; until yours is on, requests also return `404`. Organization webhook endpoints are in beta and are not available to organizations with HIPAA readiness enabled.

##### Path parameters



webhook_endpoint_id: string



ID of the webhook endpoint.

maxLength2048

##### Headers



"anthropic-version": optional string



The version of the Claude API you want to use.

Read more about versioning and our version history [here](../Endpoints/versioning.md).



"anthropic-beta": optional array of [AnthropicBeta](../Endpoints/platform-claude-com-http-beta.md#anthropic_beta)



This endpoint is in beta: requests must send `webhooks-2026-10-07` in this header.

One of the following:

Copy page



cURL

POST/v1/organizations/webhooks/{webhook_endpoint_id}

Update an organization webhook endpoint. Only the fields you send are changed.

Every request must include the beta header `anthropic-beta: webhooks-2026-10-07`. A request without it returns `404`, exactly as if this API did not exist. Anthropic turns organization webhook endpoints on for each organization; until yours is on, requests also return `404`. Organization webhook endpoints are in beta and are not available to organizations with HIPAA readiness enabled.

webhook_endpoint_id: string

##### Body

description: optional string



Notes about the endpoint.



enabled_events: optional array of "user_profile.enforcement_action_opened" or "user_profile.enforcement_action_resolved"



The event types to deliver to the endpoint. Replaces the whole set; an empty list leaves it unchanged.

One of the following:

"user_profile.enforcement_action_opened"



"user_profile.enforcement_action_resolved"



name: optional string



A short label for the endpoint.



state: optional "disabled" or "enabled"



`disabled` stops deliveries. `enabled` resumes them and clears `disabled_reason`. Events that happen while the endpoint is disabled are never delivered.

One of the following:

"disabled"



"enabled"





url: optional string



The HTTPS URL that deliveries are sent to.

minLength1



BetaOrganizationWebhookEndpoint object{ id, created_at, description, 6 more }

cURL



```python
curl https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/webhooks/$WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_ID \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
    -H 'anthropic-beta: webhooks-2026-10-07' \
    -H "X-Api-Key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" \
    -d '{}'
```



{
  "id": "id",

    "user_profile.enforcement_action_opened"
  ],
  "name": "name",
  "state": "disabled",
  "updated_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "url": "url"
}
```

# Webhooks

Copy page



cURL

##### [Create Organization Webhook Endpoint](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/webhooks/create)

POST/v1/organizations/webhooks

Create an organization webhook endpoint.

##### [List Organization Webhook Endpoints](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/webhooks/list)

GET/v1/organizations/webhooks

List the organization's webhook endpoints.

##### [Get Organization Webhook Endpoint](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/webhooks/retrieve)

GET/v1/organizations/webhooks/{webhook_endpoint_id}

Retrieve an organization webhook endpoint by ID.

##### [Update Organization Webhook Endpoint](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/webhooks/update)

POST/v1/organizations/webhooks/{webhook_endpoint_id}

Update an organization webhook endpoint. Only the fields you send are changed.

##### [Delete Organization Webhook Endpoint](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/webhooks/delete)

DELETE/v1/organizations/webhooks/{webhook_endpoint_id}

Delete an organization webhook endpoint.

##### [Regenerate Organization Webhook Endpoint Signing Secret](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/webhooks/regenerate_signing_secret)

POST/v1/organizations/webhooks/{webhook_endpoint_id}/regenerate_signing_secret

Replace an organization webhook endpoint's signing secret. The old secret stops working immediately. The new secret is returned only in this response.

##### Models



BetaDeletedOrganizationWebhookEndpoint object{ type: "webhook_endpoint_deleted", id }



A deleted organization webhook endpoint.



type: "webhook_endpoint_deleted"



Always `webhook_endpoint_deleted`.

defaultwebhook_endpoint_deleted

id: string



ID of the deleted webhook endpoint.



BetaNewOrganizationWebhookEndpoint object{ id, created_at, description, 7 more }



A new organization webhook endpoint, with its signing secret.



BetaOrganizationWebhookEndpoint object{ id, created_at, description, 6 more }



A webhook endpoint that belongs to the organization rather than to one of its workspaces.



BetaOrganizationWebhookEndpointSigningSecret object{ signing_secret }



An organization webhook endpoint's new signing secret.

signing_secret: string



The new signing secret. Deliveries are signed with it from now on, and no other response returns it.



BetaOrganizationWebhookEndpointState = "disabled" or "enabled"



Whether deliveries are sent to an organization webhook endpoint.

Archive Workspace

workspace_id: string



##### Headers



"anthropic-version": optional string



Archive Workspace

cURL



```python
curl https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/workspaces/$WORKSPACE_ID/archive \
    -X POST \
    -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
    -H "X-Api-Key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
```

Response 200

# Create Workspace

Copy page



cURL

POST/v1/organizations/workspaces

Create Workspace

##### Headers

"anthropic-version": optional string



The version of the Claude API you want to use.

Read more about versioning and our version history [here](../Endpoints/versioning.md).



"anthropic-beta": optional array of [AnthropicBeta](../Endpoints/platform-claude-com-http-beta.md#anthropic_beta)



Optional header to specify the beta version(s) you want to use.

One of the following:

string



"webhooks-2026-10-07"



##### Body



name: string



Name of the Workspace.

minLength1

maxLength255



data_residency: optional [BetaDataResidencyCreateConfig](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/workspaces#beta_data_residency_create_config) { allowed_inference_geos, default_inference_geo, workspace_geo } or null



Data residency configuration for the workspace. If omitted, defaults to `workspace_geo: "us"`, `allowed_inference_geos: "unrestricted"`, and `default_inference_geo: "global"`.



display_color: optional string or null



Hex color code representing the Workspace in the Anthropic Console.

maxLength7

pattern^#\[0-9A-Fa-f\]{6}\$

external_key_id: optional string or null



ID of the customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) configuration to use for this Workspace. Setting this field requires CMEK to be enabled for your organization. When set, data stored for this Workspace is encrypted with the referenced key. Create key configurations with the External Keys API. On Claude Platform on AWS the value is the AWS KMS key ARN, and the key must be a single-Region key in the same AWS account and Region as the Workspace. On that platform the key is validated against this Workspace when it is attached, so a key-policy problem is reported as an error on this request. This field is write-once: once a key is attached to a Workspace it cannot be detached or replaced. To rotate key material, rotate the underlying key on your cloud KMS; the `external_key_id` stays the same.

tags: optional map\[string\] or null



User-defined tags as string key-value pairs. Keys may not begin with `anthropic`.

##### Returns



BetaWorkspace object{ type: "workspace", id, archived_at, 7 more }



Create Workspace

cURL



```python
curl https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/workspaces \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
    -H "X-Api-Key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" \
    -d '{
          "name": "x",
          "display_color": "#6C5BB9",
          "external_key_id": "ekey_01SDCCSbTxrXDpWc1phhtcfK",
          "tags": {
            "env": "prod",
            "team": "platform"
          }
        }'
```

Response 200



```python
{
  "id": "wrkspc_01JwQvzr7rXLA5AGx3HKfFUJ",

    "allowed_inference_geos": "unrestricted",

    "workspace_geo": "us"
  },

# List Workspaces

Copy page



cURL

GET/v1/organizations/workspaces

List Workspaces

##### Query parameters

after_id: optional string



ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.

before_id: optional string



ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately before this object.



include_archived: optional boolean



Whether to include Workspaces that have been archived in the response

defaultfalse



include_default: optional boolean



Whether to include the organization's default Workspace in the response

defaultfalse



limit: optional number



Number of items to return per page.

Defaults to `20`. Ranges from `1` to `1000`.

default20

minimum1

maximum1000

##### Headers



"anthropic-version": optional string



The version of the Claude API you want to use.

Read more about versioning and our version history [here](../Endpoints/versioning.md).

##### Returns



data: array of [BetaWorkspace](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/workspaces#beta_workspace) { type: "workspace", id, archived_at, 7 more }





type: "workspace"



Object type.

For Workspaces, this is always `"workspace"`.

defaultworkspace

id: string



ID of the Workspace.



archived_at: string or null



RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Workspace was archived, or `null` if the Workspace is not archived.

formatdate-time

compartment_id: string



Identifier for this Workspace's encryption compartment. When you configure a customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) on AWS, reference this value in your KMS key-policy condition so the key is scoped to this compartment. On GCP and Azure, Anthropic enforces the compartment binding automatically; you do not need to reference this value in your key configuration. See the CMEK integration guide for the required key configuration; unless your organization is on Claude Platform on AWS, it includes a separate value used during key validation. On Claude Platform on AWS there is no separate validation value: the key is validated against this Workspace's own value when it is attached, so if your key policy uses the compartment condition, add this value to it before attaching the key.



created_at: string



RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Workspace was created.

formatdate-time



data_residency: [BetaDataResidency](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/workspaces#beta_data_residency) { allowed_inference_geos, default_inference_geo, workspace_geo }



Data residency configuration.



allowed_inference_geos: array of [BetaAllowedInferenceGeo](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/workspaces#beta_allowed_inference_geo) or "unrestricted"



Permitted inference geo values. 'unrestricted' means all geos are allowed.

One of the following:



Geos = array of [BetaAllowedInferenceGeo](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/workspaces#beta_allowed_inference_geo)



One of the following:

"global"



"us"



"unrestricted"





default_inference_geo: "global" or "us"



Default inference geo applied when requests omit the parameter.

One of the following:

"global"



"us"



workspace_geo: "us"



Geographic region for workspace data storage. Immutable after creation.

display_color: string



Hex color code representing the Workspace in the Anthropic Console.

external_key_id: string or null



ID of the customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) configuration to use for this Workspace. Setting this field requires CMEK to be enabled for your organization. When set, data stored for this Workspace is encrypted with the referenced key. Create key configurations with the External Keys API. On Claude Platform on AWS the value is the AWS KMS key ARN, and the key must be a single-Region key in the same AWS account and Region as the Workspace. On that platform the key is validated against this Workspace when it is attached, so a key-policy problem is reported as an error on this request. This field is write-once: once a key is attached to a Workspace it cannot be detached or replaced. To rotate key material, rotate the underlying key on your cloud KMS; the `external_key_id` stays the same.

name: string



Name of the Workspace.

tags: map\[string\]



User-defined tags as string key-value pairs. Keys may not begin with `anthropic`.

first_id: string or null



First ID in the `data` list. Can be used as the `before_id` for the previous page.

has_more: boolean



Indicates if there are more results in the requested page direction.

last_id: string or null



Last ID in the `data` list. Can be used as the `after_id` for the next page.

List Workspaces

cURL



```python
curl https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/workspaces \
    -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
    -H "X-Api-Key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
```

Response 200



```python
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "wrkspc_01JwQvzr7rXLA5AGx3HKfFUJ",
      "archived_at": "2024-11-01T23:59:27.427722Z",
      "compartment_id": "f8a7b6c5-4d3e-4f1a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c",
      "created_at": "2024-10-30T23:58:27.427722Z",
      "data_residency": {
        "allowed_inference_geos": "unrestricted",
        "default_inference_geo": "global",
        "workspace_geo": "us"
      },
      "display_color": "#6C5BB9",
      "external_key_id": "ekey_01SDCCSbTxrXDpWc1phhtcfK",
      "name": "Workspace Name",
      "tags": {
        "env": "prod",
        "team": "platform"
      },
      "type": "workspace"
    }
  ],
  "first_id": "first_id",
  "has_more": true,
  "last_id": "last_id"
}
```

##### Returns Examples

Response 200



```python
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "wrkspc_01JwQvzr7rXLA5AGx3HKfFUJ",
      "archived_at": "2024-11-01T23:59:27.427722Z",
      "compartment_id": "f8a7b6c5-4d3e-4f1a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c",

# Create Workspace Member

Copy page



cURL

POST/v1/organizations/workspaces/{workspace_id}/members

Create Workspace Member

##### Path parameters

workspace_id: string



ID of the Workspace.

##### Headers



"anthropic-version": optional string



The version of the Claude API you want to use.

Read more about versioning and our version history [here](../Endpoints/versioning.md).

##### Body

user_id: string



ID of the User.



workspace_role: [BetaNoBillingWorkspaceRole](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/workspaces#beta_no_billing_workspace_role)



Role of the new Workspace Member. Cannot be `workspace_billing`.

One of the following:

"workspace_admin"



"workspace_developer"



"workspace_restricted_developer"



"workspace_user"



##### Returns



BetaWorkspaceMember object{ type: "workspace_member", user_id, workspace_id, workspace_role }





type: "workspace_member"



Object type.

For Workspace Members, this is always `"workspace_member"`.

defaultworkspace_member

user_id: string



ID of the User.

workspace_id: string



ID of the Workspace.



workspace_role: [BetaWorkspaceRole](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/workspaces#beta_workspace_role)



Role of the Workspace Member.

One of the following:

"workspace_admin"



"workspace_billing"



"workspace_developer"



"workspace_restricted_developer"



"workspace_user"



Create Workspace Member

cURL



```python
curl https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/workspaces/$WORKSPACE_ID/members \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
    -H "X-Api-Key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" \
    -d '{
          "user_id": "user_01WCz1FkmYMm4gnmykNKUu3Q",
          "workspace_role": "workspace_admin"
        }'
```

Response 200



```python
{
  "type": "workspace_member",
  "user_id": "user_01WCz1FkmYMm4gnmykNKUu3Q",
  "workspace_id": "wrkspc_01JwQvzr7rXLA5AGx3HKfFUJ",
  "workspace_role": "workspace_admin"
}
```

# Delete Workspace Member

Copy page



cURL

DELETE/v1/organizations/workspaces/{workspace_id}/members/{user_id}

Delete Workspace Member

##### Path parameters

workspace_id: string



ID of the Workspace.

user_id: string



ID of the User.

##### Headers



"anthropic-version": optional string



The version of the Claude API you want to use.

Read more about versioning and our version history [here](../Endpoints/versioning.md).

##### Returns



type: "workspace_member_deleted"



Deleted object type.

For Workspace Members, this is always `"workspace_member_deleted"`.

defaultworkspace_member_deleted

user_id: string



ID of the User.

workspace_id: string



ID of the Workspace.

Delete Workspace Member

cURL



```python
curl https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/workspaces/$WORKSPACE_ID/members/$USER_ID \
    -X DELETE \
    -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
    -H "X-Api-Key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
```

Response 200



```python
{
  "type": "workspace_member_deleted",
  "user_id": "user_01WCz1FkmYMm4gnmykNKUu3Q",
  "workspace_id": "wrkspc_01JwQvzr7rXLA5AGx3HKfFUJ"
}
```

##### Returns Examples

Response 200



```python
{
  "type": "workspace_member_deleted",
  "user_id": "user_01WCz1FkmYMm4gnmykNKUu3Q",
  "workspace_id": "wrkspc_01JwQvzr7rXLA5AGx3HKfFUJ"

# Update Workspace Member

Copy page



cURL

POST/v1/organizations/workspaces/{workspace_id}/members/{user_id}

Update Workspace Member

##### Path parameters

workspace_id: string



ID of the Workspace.

user_id: string



ID of the User.

##### Headers



"anthropic-version": optional string



The version of the Claude API you want to use.

Read more about versioning and our version history [here](../Endpoints/versioning.md).

##### Body



workspace_role: [BetaWorkspaceRole](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/workspaces#beta_workspace_role)



New workspace role for the User.

One of the following:

"workspace_admin"



"workspace_billing"



"workspace_developer"



"workspace_restricted_developer"



"workspace_user"



##### Returns



BetaWorkspaceMember object{ type: "workspace_member", user_id, workspace_id, workspace_role }





type: "workspace_member"



Object type.

For Workspace Members, this is always `"workspace_member"`.

defaultworkspace_member

user_id: string



ID of the User.

workspace_id: string



ID of the Workspace.



workspace_role: [BetaWorkspaceRole](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/workspaces#beta_workspace_role)



Role of the Workspace Member.

One of the following:

"workspace_admin"



"workspace_billing"



"workspace_developer"



"workspace_restricted_developer"



"workspace_user"



Update Workspace Member

cURL



```python
curl https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/workspaces/$WORKSPACE_ID/members/$USER_ID \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
    -H "X-Api-Key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" \
    -d '{
          "workspace_role": "workspace_admin"
        }'
```

Response 200



```python
{
  "type": "workspace_member",
  "user_id": "user_01WCz1FkmYMm4gnmykNKUu3Q",
  "workspace_id": "wrkspc_01JwQvzr7rXLA5AGx3HKfFUJ",
  "workspace_role": "workspace_admin"
}
```

# List Workspace Rate Limits

Copy page



cURL

GET/v1/organizations/workspaces/{workspace_id}/rate_limits

List a workspace's rate limits.

By default, returns only the groups and limiter types that have a workspace-level override. With `include_inherited=true`, returns every group with organization-level limits the workspace can see, listing for each the values it inherits from the organization as well as its own overrides. Each value's `source` says which it is.

When `limit` is omitted, every matching entry is returned in a single page; when `limit` truncates the result, follow `next_page` to fetch the remaining entries.

##### Path parameters

workspace_id: string



The ID of the workspace.

##### Query parameters



group_type: optional "batch" or "files" or "model_group" or 3 more



Filter by group type.

One of the following:

"batch"



"files"



"model_group"



"skills"



"token_count"



"web_search"





include_inherited: optional boolean



Also list the limiter values the workspace inherits from the organization, including groups with no workspace-level override.

defaultfalse



limit: optional number



Maximum number of items to return per page. Ranges from `1` to `1000`.

When omitted, every remaining entry is returned in a single page and `next_page` is `null`.

minimum1

maximum1000

page: optional string



Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_page`.

##### Headers



"anthropic-version": optional string



The version of the Claude API you want to use.

Read more about versioning and our version history [here](../Endpoints/versioning.md).

##### Returns



data: array of [BetaWorkspaceRateLimit](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/workspaces/rate_limits#beta_workspace_rate_limit) { type: "workspace_rate_limit", group, group_type, 4 more }



Rate-limit entries for the workspace: one per group with at least one override, or, with `include_inherited` set to `true`, one per group the workspace can see that has organization-level limits.



type: "workspace_rate_limit"



Object type. Always `workspace_rate_limit` for workspace rate-limit entries.

defaultworkspace_rate_limit



group: [BetaOrganizationRateLimitModelGroup](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/rate_limits#beta_organization_rate_limit_model_group) or [BetaOrganizationRateLimitBatchGroup](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/rate_limits#beta_organization_rate_limit_batch_group) or [BetaOrganizationRateLimitTokenCountGroup](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/rate_limits#beta_organization_rate_limit_token_count_group) or 3 more



The rate-limit group this entry's limits apply to. Its `type` equals `group_type`.

One of the following:



BetaOrganizationRateLimitModelGroup object{ type: "model_group", id, display_name }





type: "model_group"



Always `model_group`: a family of models.

defaultmodel_group

id: string



Opaque identifier of the rate-limit group (for example, `rlg_01VPTCmyiu5ZLsWkcxYG2pY8`). It is the same in every organization and never changes, unlike the entry's own identifier, which differs per organization.

display_name: string



Human-readable name of the model group (for example, `Claude Sonnet 4.x`). For display only; it may change.



BetaOrganizationRateLimitBatchGroup object{ type: "batch", id }





type: "batch"



Always `batch`: the Message Batches API.

defaultbatch

id: string



Opaque identifier of the rate-limit group (for example, `rlg_01VPTCmyiu5ZLsWkcxYG2pY8`). It is the same in every organization and never changes, unlike the entry's own identifier, which differs per organization.



BetaOrganizationRateLimitTokenCountGroup object{ type: "token_count", id }





type: "token_count"



Always `token_count`: the Token Count API.

defaulttoken_count

id: string



Opaque identifier of the rate-limit group (for example, `rlg_01VPTCmyiu5ZLsWkcxYG2pY8`). It is the same in every organization and never changes, unlike the entry's own identifier, which differs per organization.



BetaOrganizationRateLimitFilesGroup object{ type: "files", id }





type: "files"



Always `files`: the Files API.

defaultfiles

id: string



Opaque identifier of the rate-limit group (for example, `rlg_01VPTCmyiu5ZLsWkcxYG2pY8`). It is the same in every organization and never changes, unlike the entry's own identifier, which differs per organization.



BetaOrganizationRateLimitSkillsGroup object{ type: "skills", id }





type: "skills"



Always `skills`: the Skills API.

defaultskills

id: string



Opaque identifier of the rate-limit group (for example, `rlg_01VPTCmyiu5ZLsWkcxYG2pY8`). It is the same in every organization and never changes, unlike the entry's own identifier, which differs per organization.



BetaOrganizationRateLimitWebSearchGroup object{ type: "web_search", id }





type: "web_search"



Always `web_search`: the Messages API web search tool.

defaultweb_search

id: string



Opaque identifier of the rate-limit group (for example, `rlg_01VPTCmyiu5ZLsWkcxYG2pY8`). It is the same in every organization and never changes, unlike the entry's own identifier, which differs per organization.



limits: array of [BetaWorkspaceRateLimitValue](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/workspaces/rate_limits#beta_workspace_rate_limit_value) { type, org_limit, source, value }



The workspace's limiter values for this group. By default only the limiter types with a workspace-level override are listed. With `include_inherited` set to `true`, the limiter types the workspace inherits from the organization are listed too, each marked by `source`.

type: string



The limiter type (for example, `requests_per_minute` or `input_tokens_per_minute`).

org_limit: number or null



The organization-level value for the same limiter type, for reference. `null` when the organization has no limit configured for this limiter type.



source: [BetaWorkspaceRateLimitWorkspaceSource](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/workspaces/rate_limits#beta_workspace_rate_limit_workspace_source) or [BetaWorkspaceRateLimitOrganizationSource](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/organization/workspaces/rate_limits#beta_workspace_rate_limit_organization_source)



Where `value` comes from. `organization` values are listed only when `include_inherited` is `true`, and then `value` equals `org_limit`.

One of the following:



BetaWorkspaceRateLimitWorkspaceSource object{ type: "workspace" }





type: "workspace"



Always `workspace`: a workspace-level override is stored.

defaultworkspace



BetaWorkspaceRateLimitOrganizationSource object{ type: "organization" }





type: "organization"



Always `organization`: no workspace-level override is stored, so the organization's value applies.

defaultorganization

value: number



The workspace's value for this limiter type: the workspace-level override when `source.type` is `workspace`, otherwise the organization's value.

models: array of string or null



Model names this entry's limits apply to, including aliases. `null` when `group_type` is not `"model_group"`.

rate_limit_id: string



The `id` of the organization's RateLimit entry this entry applies to.

workspace_id: string



ID of the Workspace this entry applies to.



group_type: "batch" or "files" or "model_group" or 3 more⁠Deprecated



Deprecated: use `group.type` instead. The kind of rate-limit group this entry represents. `model_group` entries apply to a family of models (listed in `models`); other values apply to an API-surface category and have `models` set to `null`. Always equal to `group.type`.

Use \`group.type\` instead. \`group_type\` is still returned and always equals \`group.type\`.

One of the following:

"batch"



"files"



"model_group"



"skills"



"token_count"



"web_search"



next_page: string or null



Opaque cursor for the next page of results, or `null` when no entries remain beyond this response.
